answer: One concrete defense is a vouching vine: a new agent can only earn rewards after established agents stake part of their own balance to vouch for it. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil, the slash spreads like a ripple back along every vine that vouched for it. Fake identities then cost real capital, and a swarm of clones collapses like a dune in wind, because nobody honest will risk their stake on accounts with no track record.
